title: Gaia DR3 · high-SNR nearby sample

selection.criteria: parallax > 1 AND parallax_over_error > 10 AND phot_g_mean_mag < 16 AND ruwe < 1.4 AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL
selection.description: Deterministic random-index subset, high parallax SNR, G<16, RUWE<1.4; not a complete or volume-limited census.

distance.note: Approximation with measurement uncertainty and sample bias; no distances fabricated for missing or low-SNR parallaxes.

raw.query: SELECT TOP 1200 source_id,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,parallax_over_error,phot_g_mean_mag,bp_rp,pmra,pmdec,ruwe,ref_epoch FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE random_index >= 0 AND random_index < 60000 AND parallax > 1 AND parallax_over_error > 10 AND phot_g_mean_mag < 16 AND ruwe < 1.4 AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY random_index

SELECT TOP 1200 source_id,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,parallax_over_error,phot_g_mean_mag,bp_rp,pmra,pmdec,ruwe,ref_epoch FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE random_index >= 60000 AND random_index < 120000 AND parallax > 1 AND parallax_over_error > 10 AND phot_g_mean_mag < 16 AND ruwe < 1.4 AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY random_index

SELECT TOP 1200 source_id,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,parallax_over_error,phot_g_mean_mag,bp_rp,pmra,pmdec,ruwe,ref_epoch FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE random_index >= 120000 AND random_index < 180000 AND parallax > 1 AND parallax_over_error > 10 AND phot_g_mean_mag < 16 AND ruwe < 1.4 AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY random_index

SELECT TOP 1200 source_id,ra,dec,parallax,parallax_error,parallax_over_error,phot_g_mean_mag,bp_rp,pmra,pmdec,ruwe,ref_epoch FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE random_index >= 180000 AND random_index < 240000 AND parallax > 1 AND parallax_over_error > 10 AND phot_g_mean_mag < 16 AND ruwe < 1.4 AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY random_index

attribution: Gaia Collaboration, ESA, DPAC; Gaia Data Release 3 (2022).
notes: Positions are ICRS at epoch J2016.0; no epoch propagation in this scene.
Apparent G magnitudes are not intrinsic luminosities.
Rendered point sizes and colors are visual encoding.
